title: Mariam El Jouzou
text:
Python in Practice
In a previous course, I used Python and SQL to analyze business data, including sales trends and performance. Here is a simple example of using Python to summarize monthly sales:

monthly_sales = [12500, 14800, 13200, 15600, 17100]
average_sales = sum(monthly_sales) / len(monthly_sales)

print(f"Average Monthly Sales: ${average_sales:,.2f}")

Average Monthly Sales: $14,640.00

title: About Me
text:
Hi! I’m Mariam El Jouzou, a graduate student in Applied Business Analytics at Boston University with a professional background in marketing.
I enjoy connecting data to business and understanding how insights can be used to support better decisions and solve real-world challenges. Through my graduate studies, I’m continuing to build my technical and analytical skills and explore new ways to apply data in a business setting.
